profile.name: SSH远程客户端
profile.description: 一个非实体的软件组件，用于在实验系统中通过 SSH 和 SFTP 与远程主机通信。它可获取连接与传输会话、上传和下载文件、启动远程命令，并读取命令通道输出，常用于实验控制计算机、远程节点或数据处理主机之间的自动化交互。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for communicating with remote hosts over SSH and SFTP in laboratory systems. It can obtain connection and transport sessions, upload and download files, start remote commands, and read command-channel output, commonly used for automation between experiment controllers, remote nodes, and data-processing hosts.
